testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.data.transport.BleSessionOwnerTest

testcase.name: single active host connects and second host is rejected()
disconnect fences session generation and allows reconnection()
commands are rejected when revision or notifications are not ready()
disabling notifications erases partial request assembly()
MTU update recalculates write and notify capacities correctly()
side effect runs only for the active session generation()
assembleRequest reassembles multi-packet message within 3s deadline()
unrelated disconnect preserves active host while addressless disconnect resets it()
CCCD notification subscription and revision are required for command readiness()
message value identity includes CTAP payload and session generation()
assembly expiry ignores stale generation and token then expires the matching request()
malformed initialization length and oversized continuation return typed errors()
assembleRequest times out after 3 seconds without continuation()
write and notify capacities honor platform maximum limits()
